svg.title: About
svg.desc: I build backend systems for AI infrastructure billing at CoreWeave. Previously maintained the AWS Python SDK (boto3) and worked at The New York Times. Mostly Python, Java, and Go — shipping the boring reliable stuff that keeps money and meters honest.
